login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the email and password your administrator gave you.
login.help: Forgot your password? Ask your system administrator to reset it.
login.fieldError: Check the email and password, then try again.

invalid.title: Email or password is wrong.
invalid.body: Check both and try again. After 5 wrong tries, sign-in pauses for 15 minutes.

locked.title: Sign-in is paused for this email.
locked.body_one: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {{count}} minute, or ask your administrator.
locked.body_other: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {{count}} minutes, or ask your administrator.

offline.title: No connection to the server.
offline.body: Check the network, then try again. Nothing you typed is lost.

other.title: Something went wrong.
other.body: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, tell your administrator.

login.statementShort: Orders, machines, stock and shifts in one place.
login.statementLong: Orders, machines, stock and shifts in one place, from the receipt to the finished goods store.

details.title: Your details
details.note: To change your name or roles, ask an administrator.

display.title: Display
display.note: Saved to your account, so it follows you to any device. Dates are stored exactly either way.

password.title: Change password
password.sub: Choose a password only you know. At least 10 characters.
password.subForced: Your administrator set a temporary password. Choose your own to continue.
password.rules: At least 10 characters, and different from your current password.
password.note: Your other devices are signed out when you change it. This one stays signed in.
password.noteForced: You will go straight to the app after saving.
password.errSame: Choose a password different from the current one.
password.errMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
password.okBody: Your other devices were signed out.

offline.title: No connection to the server.
offline.body: Check the network, then try again. Nothing you typed is lost.

other.title: Something went wrong.
other.body: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, tell your administrator.

status.label: Status
status.offHelp: This person cannot sign in. Their records stay.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.body: {{name}} will not be able to sign in, and any open sessions end now. Their records stay. You can turn them back on later.

form.emailLocked: The email cannot be changed after the user is created.
form.passwordHelp: At least 10 characters. Tell it to the person in private.
form.rolesHelp: Pick one or more. Roles decide what the person can see and do.

reset.sectionBody: Choose a new password for this person. All their open sessions end.
reset.title: Reset password for {{name}}
reset.sessionsBody: All of {{name}}'s open sessions end when you reset the password. They must choose a new password when they sign in.

result.body: Copy this password now. It is not shown again. Tell {{name}} in private.
result.mustChange: They must choose a new password the first time they sign in.

empty.title: No users yet
empty.body: Add the people who will sign in. Each person gets one or more roles that decide what they can see and do.

loadError.title: Could not load users.
loadError.body: Check the connection and try again.

errors.title: Something went wrong.
errors.lastAdmin: You cannot remove the last administrator.
errors.lastAdminBody: Make someone else an administrator first, then try again.

errors.invalidEmail: This is not a valid email address.
errors.unknownRole: One of the roles no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.notFound: This user no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.passwordChangeRequired: You must choose a new password first.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check the network and try again.
errors.other: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, tell your administrator.

loadError.title: Could not load the list.
loadError.body: Check the connection and try again.

errors.invalidInput: Check the fields and try again.

materials.intro: Raw materials and additives that recipes use, bought through purchase orders. Names are kept in both languages.
materials.emptyBody: Add the raw materials and additives you buy. Recipes pick their ingredients from this list.
materials.kindLocked: The kind cannot be changed after the material is added.
materials.retireBody: It will no longer be offered when writing recipes. Recipes and history that already use it keep it. You can bring it back later.
materials.autoItems: Finished goods and regrind items are created automatically for every product, colour and regrind source. You do not add them here.

products.emptyBody: Add what Crown makes. Each product gets colours, and each colour gets a recipe.
products.packageNeededPieces: Enter how many pieces are in one package.
products.packageNeededKg: Enter how many kg are in one bag.
products.soldByHelp: Cannot be changed later, so quantities are never mixed up.
products.soldByLocked: Fixed once a recipe exists, so quantities can never be mixed up.
products.weightHelp: Used only to convert between pieces and kilograms. A converted figure is always labelled as converted.
products.addNext: Next you add the first colour. A finished goods item is created for each colour automatically.
products.retireBody: It will no longer be offered for new orders or recipes. Existing orders, stock and history keep it. You can bring it back later.

colours.addNote: A finished goods item is created for this colour automatically. Add its recipe next.
colours.retireBody: {{name}} will no longer be offered for new production orders or recipes. Existing orders, stock and history keep it. You can bring it back later.
colours.emptyBody: Each colour has its own recipe. Add the first colour to continue.

recipe.title: {{colour}} recipe
recipe.regrindSub: Which damaged output of other products may go back into this recipe
recipe.noRegrindTitle: Regrind is not allowed in this recipe
recipe.noRegrindBody: Damaged output of any product goes to waste handling instead.
recipe.toleranceSub: How far real use may differ from this recipe before an alert
recipe.toleranceNote: Leave as shown to keep using the settings defaults.
recipe.emptyBody: Copy the recipe of another colour and change it, or start with an empty one.
recipe.readerEmpty: An administrator has to add this recipe.
recipe.historyNote: Every saved version is kept. Nothing is overwritten.
recipe.editInfoBody: The current version stays in the history. New production uses the new version.
recipe.noMoreMaterials: All materials are already in the recipe
recipe.discardBody: What you changed on this page will be lost.
recipe.savedBody: New production uses it. Version {{previous}} is kept in the history.
recipe.conflictBody: Your changes were not saved. Look at the new version, or start again from it.

errors.invalidQuantity: Enter a quantity above zero, up to 6 decimals.
errors.invalidBlend: Enter a percentage above 0 and up to 100, or leave empty.
errors.toleranceOrder: Warning must be lower than critical.
errors.reasonRequired: Say why you are changing the recipe.
errors.duplicateIngredient: This material is already in the recipe.
errors.unitNotAllowed: This unit is not allowed for this material.
errors.duplicateSource: This regrind source is already in the recipe.
errors.unknownSource: This regrind source no longer exists.

recipe.copiedRecipe: Copied from another colour. First recipe for this colour
